prompt:
Create a fresh wide 3:2 landing-page hero illustration of a bustling cartoon gym. The ENTIRE IMAGE must be unmistakably hand-drawn cartoon art: the room, floor, windows, mirrors, machines, weights, plants, and every animal. Use an original golden-age theatrical slapstick animation aesthetic with thick lively tapered ink lines, hand-painted cel colors, simple graphic shadows, squash-and-stretch, curved playful equipment shapes, expressive staging, and softly brushed painted background flats. Absolutely no photorealism, no realistic fur strands, no 3D rendering, no photographic lighting, no realistic materials, no hyper-detailed gym machinery, and no live-action look. Do not copy or resemble any existing copyrighted cartoon character, costume, signature face, or trademarked design.

Show a proper, recognizable gym as a cohesive cartoon environment: a curved row of treadmills by oversized sunny windows, an organized dumbbell rack and two benches in a free-weight area, a small strength rack in the back, a green stretching-mat corner, a water cooler and towel shelf, a continuous dark teal rubber floor, warm cream walls, coral accents, and clear walking paths. Everything should share the same simplified hand-painted cartoon language. No colored activity tiles, outlined zones, diagram layout, reception desk, lounge chair, couch, coffee table, domestic furniture, text, signs, labels, logos, UI, callouts, circles, or hotspots.

Populate the gym with charming, highly stylized anthropomorphic animal cartoons with big expressive eyes, oversized heads, rounded muzzles, clean simplified fur shapes, white-glove-like paws without copying any known character, bouncy silhouettes, and playful workout clothes. Include: a cheerful bear doing standing dumbbell curls with controlled form; a lanky rabbit running forward on a treadmill; a red panda lying face-up doing a safe dumbbell bench press; a cat stretching on a mat; an otter drinking from a water bottle near the cooler; a fox and raccoon chatting beside—but not blocking—a bench; and a small hedgehog choosing a dumbbell. The characters should feel alive and funny through facial expressions and pose, but the exercise setup, body orientation, equipment contact, and gym etiquette must remain physically understandable and safe.

Strict craft: coherent anatomy, correct limb count, no upside-down heads, no clipping, no characters sitting on one another, no floating weights, no impossible grips, no overlapping player controls or text, no malformed equipment, and no awkward empty reception area. Use a dynamic high-angle composition with a natural foreground-to-background flow rather than a rigid grid. Palette: warm cream, deep teal-blue, coral, lichen green, and warm brown. Premium, cute, lively, mobile-crop-safe, and visually readable at small size. No text, letters, numbers, brands, watermark, or speech bubbles.
